info.name: Ignition Dashboard — Backend QA
info.description:
Every request in docs/manual-qa.md, pre-built. Run the folders top to bottom.

Tokens and ids are captured automatically into collection variables, so you never paste a token by hand.

Before you start: the server must be running (`npm run dev` in the backend folder).

item.name: 1 — Setup
item.description: manual-qa §1. Proves the server is up and talking to Atlas.

item.name: 2 — Registration and login
item.description: manual-qa §2. Creates the hacker account used by the rest of the run.

exec: // 409 here just means you already ran this once - that is fine.
console.log('2.8 - paste this into jwt.io:', b.token);

item.name: 2.7  POST login unknown email  -> 401, same message

exec: pm.test('2.7 message identical to 2.6 (no email enumeration)', () =>

item.name: 3.5  PATCH /users/me role admin  -> ignored, still hacker

exec: pm.test('3.5 status is 200 (not an error)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('3.5 role still hacker - privilege escalation blocked', () =>

item.name: 4 — Get an organizer (manual-qa 7.1)
item.description:
There is no HTTP route that creates an organizer or admin.

Run 'register admin-to-be' FIRST, then STOP and promote that user to `admin` by hand in Atlas -> Browse Collections -> users. Then run the rest of this folder.

item.name: 4a  POST register admin-to-be   [then promote in Atlas]

exec: console.log('>>> STOP. In Atlas -> Browse Collections -> users, find', pm.collectionVariables.get('adminEmail'), 'and set role to "admin". Then continue.');

item.name: 4c  POST login as admin  -> 200 (role must be admin)

exec: pm.test('4c role is admin (did you promote in Atlas?)', () =>

item.name: 5 — Schedule writing
item.description: manual-qa §5. Creates the events that section 6 then reads.

exec: pm.test('5.3 day derived from startTime', () => pm.expect(b.day).to.eql('2026-08-14'));
pm.test('5.3 isFoodEvent false for Main', () => pm.expect(b.isFoodEvent).to.eql(false));
pm.test('5.3 isFoodEvent true for Food', () => pm.expect(b.isFoodEvent).to.eql(true));

item.name: 5.9  PATCH startTime to another date  -> day changes

exec: pm.test('5.10 status is 400 - validators re-run on update', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: 6 — Schedule reading
item.description:
manual-qa §4. Run AFTER folder 5 so there are events to read.

4.3 (sort order) and 4.4 (no blank fields) are asserted here, but LOOK at the response body yourself too - that is the point of manual QA.

exec: pm.test('4.4 no blank title / startTime / location', () =>
pm.test('4.5 every event is on that day', () =>
pm.test('4.6 all Food, all isFoodEvent true', () =>
pm.test('4.10 is the event itself', () => pm.expect(b.title).to.be.a('string'));

item.name: 7.2b Reuse the OLD hacker token on a write  -> 201 (no re-login)

exec: pm.test('7.2b old token now passes the organizer gate', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: 8 — Cleanup (shared DB - please run this)
item.description: ignition-dashboard-dev is shared with Youssef and Jeremy. Remove the QA events so their schedule stays clean.
